caption: AI Agent Stop Information
description: The AI Agent Stop Information object provides detail pertaining to the AI Agent Activity: Stop event type.
name: ai_agent_stop_info

type.caption: Stop Type
type.description: The stop type, normalized to the caption of the type_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the source.

0.caption: Unknown
0.description: The turn ended for an unknown reason.

1.caption: End of Turn
1.description: The turn ended naturally. The model has returned a complete response.

2.caption: Interrupt
2.description: The turn ended prematurely having been interrupted by the user. Any response returned is incomplete.

3.caption: Token Limit
3.description: The turn ended abnormally due to token exhaustion. Any response returned is incomplete.

4.caption: Failed
4.description: The turn ended abnormally due to an unrecoverable failure. Any response returned is incomplete.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The turn ended for a reason that is not mapped. See the type attribute which contains an event source specific value.
